d:
Matchday 07 starts off with a big surprise! Mönchengladbach pull off a major upset with their victory over Stuttgart. In a high-scoring match between Mainz and Bremen, the Green-Whites ultimately secure a win, while Leipzig dominates Elversberg. The matches between Köln and Schalke, and Augsburg and Union Berlin, both end in draws. Dortmund pull off a late victory over Frankfurt and on Sunday, Hoffenheim secure a decisive victory over Leverkusen with late goals, and Bayern are on top of the table with a win over Freiburg.
Watch all the highlights of Matchday 07 in our XXL highlight show!
